description:
A June 10, 2026 canon provenance node minted by Lee Sharks / MANUS against *The New Human Standing Canon v0.3*. It records Emily Dickinson’s archive-internal status as a **Foundational Voice of New Human**, inducted jointly with Whitman in October 2025.

The node presents Dickinson as a precedent for interpretive recursion, structural openness, unauthorized archival practice, fragmentary precision, and retrocausal canon formation. Its textual ground is the complete poems, letters, and fascicles; imported relations connect Sappho, Whitman, the Hebrew scriptural-poetic tradition, and later archive practices. This is a routing/provenance node, not a replacement for Dickinson biography or textual scholarship.
